sections.section: RULES - Privatization Commission (Modes and Procedures) Rules 2001
sections.description:
PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION (MODES AND
PRIVATIZATION COMMISSION (MODES AND
PROCEDURES) RULES, 2001
(Amendment of R.5)
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
18th June, 2011]
S.R.O. 631(I)/2011, dated 18-6-2011.---In exercise of the
powers conferred by section 40 of the Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2000
(No. LII of 2000), read with section 22 and clause (f) of section 25 thereof,
the Privatization Commission, with the approval of the Federal Government, is
pleased to direct that the following further amendment shall be made in the
Privatization Commission (Modes and Procedures) Rules, 2001, namely:--
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 5, clause (c), for the full
stop appearing at the end, a semi-colon and the word "; and" shall be
substituted and thereafter the following new clause added, namely:--
"(d) transfer of shares on conversion of
exchangeable bonds or any other hybrid debt equity instrument issued by the
President, on behalf of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, provided that the
concerned Divisions of the Federal Government under the Rules of Business, 1973
are consulted, where required.".
